column1: # Observation-station registry: every place a number on the board can come from.
# Buoy rows match Ocean_Buoys_HUB/config/buoys.tsv; mesonet and tide rows are lifted
# from the Model Viewer V2 ETL (etl/etl/mesonet_config.py, noaa_waterlevel_config.py),
# where they were already confirmed live.
# src_id     id used in sites.tsv obs_* columns
# vars       canonical columns this source can supply
# endpoint   path/id fragment; the fetcher composes the full URL from machine.env
# max_age_h  older than this = stale; the site falls through to the next source
# link       where a mariner can go to see this source's own page
#            or '-'. The /metric/ variant is REQUIRED: the /us/ one returns
#            imperial numbers while labelling them with metric units inside
#            its `values` object (85.4 tagged both F and C), so only the
#            top-level value+unit pair of /metric/ is self-consistent.
# notes      free text; stale/offline/retired marks the source down
